title: Evaluating the Treatment in the MZEB Aachen
brief_summary: Evaluation of patient characteristics, involved physicians and therapists as well as therapies in a German University Center for the Treatment of patients with intellectual disabilities and severe multiple disability (MZEB Aachen)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* intellectual disability and/or severe multiple disability (disability degree GdB at least 70 and at least one noticeable sign
* willing to participate

Exclusion Criteria:

* housed in an Institution and/or prison
study_population: Mixed Population of People with intellectual and severe multiple disability who need this care in this center
